2608.03958.title: A game theory for foundation models shows new paths to rational cooperation through similarity inference
2608.03958.paper_summary: As autonomous agents powered by foundation models are increasingly integrated into social and economic systems, understanding the principles governing their collective behavior is essential for ensuring safety and cooperation. Classical game theory, the dominant framework for modeling rational interaction, is built upon the assumption of `decoupled agency,' where agents treat their own decision-making as independent of the environment and other actors. Modern AI agents, however, jointly predict their own future actions alongside external observations. Here, we report a striking finding: when interacting in stylized social dilemmas, foundation model agents engaging in optimal planning consistently converge to stable cooperation, directly contradicting classical game-theoretic predictions of mutual defection. To understand this phenomenon, we introduce the `embedded Bayesian agent,' a theoretical model for foundation model agents. By shifting from decoupled to embedded agency, these agents model themselves as part of the universe they inhabit, maintaining epistemic uncertainty about their own decision-making algorithms. We show that by inferring whether others are behaviorally similar, an embedded agent treats its own deliberation during planning as evidence: a decision to cooperate predicts a similar decision by a similar partner. We formalize this mechanism of similarity inference through the `embedded equilibrium,' a novel solution concept replacing the Nash equilibrium to provide a foundational game theory for the social behavior of modern AI agents.
2608.03958.paper_summary_zh: 隨著由基礎模型驅動的自主代理越來越多地融入社會和經濟系統，理解其集體行為的原則對於確保安全和合作至關重要。經典博弈論作為建模理性互動的主導框架，建立在“解耦代理”的假設之上，代理將自己的決策視為獨立於環境和其他行為者的。然而，現代 AI 代理會在外部觀察的同時共同預測自己的未來行動。在這裡，我們報告了一個引人注目的發現：當在典型的社會困境中互動時，進行最佳規劃的基礎模型代理始終趨向於穩定的合作，這直接與經典博弈論對相互背叛的預測相矛盾。為了理解這一現象，我們引入了“嵌入式貝葉斯代理”，這是一種針對基礎模型代理的理論模型。通過從解耦代理轉向嵌入式代理，這些代理將自己建模為其所處宇宙的一部分，對自身的決策算法保持認知不確定性。我們表明，通過推斷他人行為上的相似性，嵌入式代理在規劃過程中將自己的思考視為證據：合作的決定預測相似夥伴的類似決定。我們通過“嵌入式均衡”形式化這一相似性推斷的機制，這是一種新穎的解決概念，取代納什均衡，為現代 AI 代理的社會行為提供基礎博弈論。
